play: Landmark engineering velocity after the rightsizing
thesis: Halliburton cut 20-40% of staff in several divisions and about $100M a quarter of labor cost, yet Landmark still has to ship DecisionSpace 365, integrate InformatiQ, and support air-gapped deployments, while corporate IT runs an SAP S/4 migration and recovers from the 2024 cyber incident. Devin adds product-engineering and security capacity without adding back headcount.

why_now.t: Rightsizing is done and the labor savings are booked. Now delivery has to hold up with fewer people.
The InformatiQ acquisition brings new cloud-native code to integrate.
Landmark is hiring AI agent architects. Agents are on the agenda, but they're building, not buying.
The Aug 2024 breach cost ~$35M. Security spending still gets approved.

challenges.stated: 'Rightsizing our operations and overhead' cuts quarterly labor cost by ~$100M.
challenges.devin: Keep the release cadence with a smaller team, using parallel Devins on tests, upgrades and fixes.

challenges.stated: Layoffs of roughly 20-40% in several divisions, according to reports.
challenges.devin: Capture product knowledge in DeepWiki; work through the maintenance backlog.

challenges.stated: InformatiQ integration into the Landmark portfolio.
challenges.devin: Integration code, API adapters and test harnesses built in parallel.

challenges.stated: SAP S/4 migration cost $50M in Q3 2025 alone.
challenges.devin: Custom-code and interface remediation reduces SI spend.

challenges.stated: Cyber incident Aug 2024: data exfiltrated, ~$35M cost. AI-driven attacks cited as a risk.
challenges.devin: Security Swarm and Code Scans across internal and product estates.

challenges.stated: The iEnergy restricted mode has no outbound connectivity.
challenges.devin: Devin validates releases for restricted deployments in its own isolated test machines.

pain_chain.pain: Margin expansion via 'differentiated technology' with a smaller labor base.
pain_chain.measure: Operating margin; labor cost per quarter

pain_chain.pain: The Landmark roadmap and integrations have fewer engineers to deliver them.

pain_chain.level: L3 Landmark engineering directors, IT directors
pain_chain.pain: Test and release validation for many deployment modes; S/4 interfaces.

com.elevator: You've taken $100M a quarter out of labor and still have to ship Landmark and land S/4. Devin is an autonomous AI engineer that works the product and security backlog in parallel, with tests and recordings, so the roadmap holds without rehiring.
before: Fewer engineers on a large legacy portfolio
Restricted and air-gapped release validation done by hand
negative: Landmark slips against SLB and Shape Digital partners
Another incident hits a regulated customer
after: Parallel Devins on upgrades, tests and integrations
Repeatable release validation in isolated machines
required: Proof of work on every PR
proof: Show Devin as a tool Landmark's AI architects can use, not a competitor
